dict.string: Agello uses your Calendar on this iPhone to check your schedule, find free time, and add events you confirm.
Agello uses your Reminders on this iPhone to read your lists and add reminders you confirm.
Agello searches your Contacts locally on this iPhone to look up names, phone numbers, and email addresses when you ask.
Agello sets timers and alarms you confirm on this iPhone so they can alert you reliably.
